- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested continuing to learn bird calls, studying bird shapes and silhouettes, observing plumage patterns and colors, focusing on habitat and behavior, using field guides and apps, practicing regularly, joining a birding community, keeping a life list and journal, being patient, and taking notes and photos.

- [PREFERENCE] The user has always wanted to visit Costa Rica for its amazing bird diversity.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips on preparing for a birding trip abroad, especially in Costa Rica, including researching bird species and habitats, planning an itinerary, choosing a local guide, packing essential gear, health and safety preparations, learning some Spanish, staying flexible, respecting local culture, staying organized, and enjoying the experience.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended the field guide "Birds of Costa Rica" by Richard Garrigues and Robert Dean as a comprehensive resource for identifying birds in the field.
